flags.codex: custom model_provider (base_url, env_key, wire_api=responses); sandbox_mode=workspace-write; projects trusted; exec --skip-git-repo-check
flags.crush: crushrc: provider add (type messages, base-url, dummy key) + model add; -y (yolo); -m model; XDG_RUNTIME_DIR private; project-init dialog pre-dismissed (.crush/init); Go binary run directly, not the npm node wrapper
flags.goose: GOOSE_PROVIDER=anthropic, GOOSE_MODEL, ANTHROPIC_HOST+ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, GOOSE_DISABLE_KEYRING=1, GOOSE_MODE=auto; telemetry consent pre-answered with its default (yes)
flags.aa: serve --idle-sleep 300 (aa.service default); isolated state/agent dir; models.json anthropic.baseUrl+dummy key; settings defaultModel; HL_BUILTIN_MODELS=/dev/null (catalog from models-store only); PI_BUS_NO_NOTIFY=1, notify-send/systemctl stubs (no desktop side effects)
